description: Fetch the full augmented markdown for one MIND Front Layer template. Returns a self-contained spec — when to create a document of this type, what slots to fill, and how to store the filled copy. Always read the template before writing a typed document.

type.description: One of the 16 canonical types, upper-case (e.g. SOUL, BEHAVIOR, LESSON, POLICY, GOAL). Use mind_list_templates to see all valid values.

name: mind_get_template
